metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "C4 model of the online banking platform" {

    model {
        customer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who uses the platform to manage their accounts, move money, and track their activity."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform owned and operated by our company." {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts." "Web Application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app." "Application"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records." "Application"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers." "Application"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers." "Application"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards." "Application"
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud." "Application"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts." "Application"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers." "Application"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements." "Application"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits." "Application"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates." "Application"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation." "Application"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts." "Queue"
            ledgerDb = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement." "Database"
            customerDb = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records." "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data." "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs." "Database"
        }

        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "Routes card authorisations. Operated by a different organization." "External System"
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "Performs credit checks. Operated by a different organization." "External System"

        customer -> bankPortal "uses to manage accounts, move money, and track activity"
        customer -> webPortal "logs in and manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"
        customer -> mobileAppBackend "via the bank's mobile app"

        webPortal -> accountService "uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDb "updates"
        transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions with"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events to"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events from"
        statementsService -> ledgerDb "reads"
        statementsService -> documentStore "writes"
        batchScheduler -> ledgerDb "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDb "reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"
        onboardingService -> customerDb "reads"

        paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations through"
        onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks through"
    }

    views {
        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "System context view of the Bank Portal" {
            include customer
            include bankPortal
            include cardPaymentNetwork
            include creditReferenceAgency
            autoLayout
        }
        container bankPortal "Container" "Container view of the Bank Portal" {
            include bankPortal
            include customer
            include webPortal
            include mobileAppBackend
            include accountService
            include transactionService
            include paymentService
            include cardService
            include fraudDetectionService
            include notificationService
            include onboardingService
            include statementsService
            include directDebitService
            include exchangeRatesService
            include batchScheduler
            include eventQueue
            include ledgerDb
            include customerDb
            include auditDb
            include cache
            include documentStore
            include cardPaymentNetwork
            include creditReferenceAgency
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}
